other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Immature form of a lobula columnar neuron (Konstantinides et al., 2022).
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Parent of the new immature LC10a term (used until FBbt #2219 was released).

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Subtype of lobula columnar neuron LC10B. It has its main arbors in lobula layers 3, 4 and 5B, with some processes extending into layer 2 and some branches in layers 5 and 6. Presynaptic sites are observed in layer 3. It is a cholinergic neuron (Davis et al., 2020). It is involved in the detection of fly-sized objects and its sensitivity increases during male courtship or female aggression (Schretter et al., 2025).
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Mature form, used from the pharate adult stage; no immature form in FBbt.

recommendation: Map to FBbt:00053671 'immature lobula columnar neuron LC10a' (exact match).
